candidate.final_assistant_text:
I updated the Settings UI so that when Cassette is the selected screen, its cassette-variant control now appears immediately below the screen control, while preserving all existing controls and behavior.

What I changed

- File: lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart
  - Removed the cassette-variant row from the CassetteScreenConfig() display portion (so it’s no longer rendered inside the DISPLAY group after the cassette’s other controls).
  - Injected a new cassette-variant row directly after the screen row in the LOOK group when CassetteScreenConfig is active.
    - This uses a conditional insertion:
      if (cfg is CassetteScreenConfig) ...[
        _Cycle('void-settings-cassette-variant', 'variant', cassetteVariantMeta[cfg.variant]!.label, () {
          final next = CassetteVariant.values[(cfg.variant.index + 1) % CassetteVariant.values.length];
          settings.saveScreenConfig(cfg.copyWith(variant: next));
        }),
      ],
  - Result: The cassette-variant control appears immediately under the Screen row whenever Cassette is selected, matching the requested behavior.

Why this preserves existing behavior

- All other controls (text size, haptics) remain exactly as they were, just moved from theCassetteScreenConfig() portion to still appear, but now below the screen row via the LOOK group.
- The cassette variant cycling logic remains unchanged; it simply moves to be shown right after the screen selection, ensuring users see the variant option as soon as Cassette is chosen.
- No changes to the data model or other screens; only UI ordering.

How to verify locally

- Build and run on Linux (assuming you have a Linux desktop with a Flutter dev environment):
  - flutter pub get
  - flutter run -d linux
- Open Settings
- In the LOOK group, switch the Screen to Cassette
  - You should now see the cassette variant control immediately below the Screen row
  - The remaining controls (text size and haptics) remain present after the variant control
- Changing the variant cycles through Tape Mono, Tape Amber, Tape Colour, and Minimal as before
- All other groups (MODE, LIBRARY, EXTERNAL, etc.) retain their previous behavior

What you’ll see (text representation of the relevant region)

- LOOK group, Cassette selected
- Screen: Cassette
- Variant: Tape Mono  (now appears directly below the Screen row)
- Immersive, Transport, Browser, Full screen, UI-scale, etc. continue as before

ASCII mock screenshot (representative of the UI region)

Note: This is a text representation to illustrate placement. A real screenshot would be captured from a running Flutter app.

LOOK
- theme: (current)
- variant: (current theme variant)
- screen: cassette
  - variant: Tape Mono
- immersive: on
- transport: bottom
- browser: fixed
- full screen: off
- ui scale: 1.0x
...

Where to find the changes

- lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart
  - Cassette variant row removal: inside the CassetteScreenConfig() displayRows block
  - Cassette variant inline insertion: inside buildGroups, after the Screen row in the LOOK group

Notes

- I avoided adding any new assets or fixture files; this keeps consistency with your “use the 10 fixture files” constraint.
- If you want me to also adjust unit tests or add a small UI regression test to cover the Cassette variant being shown directly after the Screen row, I can add that as a follow-up.

Would you like me to also generate a formal image-based screenshot (PNG) of the updated Settings region for verification, or provide a ready-to-run script to capture a screenshot from a running instance?
